description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order declare that the Value Added Tax shall be  charged on import or Supply of imported cane or beet sugar.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory order under the Value Added Tax Act, specifying tax rates on imported goods. It constitutes a statutory instrument that modifies tax regulations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making a personnel appointment, so it does not qualify as a government personnel or hybrid gazette.
